Consolidated ATIF common-transcript stack. Transcript redaction, collection-runner envelope validation, and the gold-table derivations (`transcript_daily`, `transcript_tools_daily`, `workspace_user_message`) now handle the ATIF-shaped records (`header`, `step`, `observation`) alongside the legacy vintage, with token counters allowlisted so ATIF's token-id and logprob fields can never reach the lake. The per-layer entries in this PR's other `mngr-atif-*.md` files carry the full dispositions.
